eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Chelan, WA; at 3:34 PM on AUG 21, 2024 Effective until 5:34 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
Chelan County Sheriff WILDFIRE WARNING, Level 2 Evacuation Get Ready for Stayman Flats Fire, Hawks Meadow Rd., Chukar Run, Dove Hollow Rd, Big Sage Lane, Hawks Ridge Rd, Columbia Rim Rd and Downie Canyon Rd. Roads/evacuation routes can become blocked; if you do not leave now, you could be trapped, injured, or killed. For updates check Local Radio/TV or the Chelan County Emergency Mangement Website and Facebook.
